notes: Values live in Key Vault. Installing secrets onto the host as 0400 files is a separate later ticket; this PR creates infrastructure only and the prod VM holds no secrets until a release ticket.
routes_runtime_traffic is false: enable_azure_openai creates resources only and routes no runtime traffic. Prod has no LLM traffic until a separate later cutover.
The shared model account key must never be loaded into prod. WORKSPACE_LLM_API_KEY is declared only at the later LLM cutover, not in this first-apply profile.
Module output azure_openai_endpoint is the Cognitive account base URL, not the app WORKSPACE_LLM_ENDPOINT setting form until the app cutover ticket.
REAL_PATIENT_RECORDING_ENABLED stays false in the production hosting profile.
allow_extension_operations stays true for the monitor agent; Run Command must never carry secret values (CTO decision, 11 Nov 2026).
